item.title: One Nation MP rejects $200,000 staffer as Hanson accuses PM of meddling
item.description: One Nation says it will not be bought or divided by the prime minister as a bitter dispute over his power to allocate parliamentary staff intensifies.

media:group.media:description: Pauline Hanson has criticised the prime minister over "grubby" parliamentary staffing system.

item.title: Less than a week from midterms, Trump is very, very unpopular in the US
item.description: Donald Trump wants American voters to "pretend" he's on the ballot these midterm elections. Voters don't need to be reminded how much they dislike him.

media:group.media:description: US President Donald Trump is facing a poll on his popularity with the upcoming midterm elections.

item.title: Israeli election chief demands foreign interference probe as neither bloc wins majority
item.description: The fallout from Israel's inconclusive election takes another dramatic turn amid allegations of foreign interference.

media:group.media:description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his Likud party have alleged that Arab-Israeli politicians have tried to steal the election.

item.title: Late Lyon wicket puts Australia in control of deciding Test
item.description: South Africa loses four wickets and has a lead of just 40 runs, as Nathan Lyon claims the crucial wicket of Temba Bavuma in the shadows of stumps on day three in Cape Town.

media:group.media:description: Travis Head, second right, caught Aiden Markram dfor just a single run.

item.title: Triple-murderer Erin Patterson to learn her appeal fate today
item.description: Victoria's Court of Appeal will announce its decision on the mushroom killer's bid to have her convictions overturned.
item.dc:creator: Melissa Brown

media:group.media:description: Erin Patterson is currently serving three life sentences over the murder of her relatives.

item.title: Spain begins three days of mourning as train crash death toll reaches 74
item.description: Spain has begun three days of mourning after its second high-speed rail collision this year killed 74 people.

item.title: Russell Brand's wife tells court actor's promiscuity left her 'heartbroken'
item.description: Russell Brand is on trial in London charged with the rape, sexual assault and attempted indecent assault of six women between 1999 and 2009.
item.dc:creator: Claire Campbell and Bridget Rollason

media:group.media:description: Russell Brand arrived at London's Southwark Crown Court with his wife Laura.

item.title: Russian drone strike on Ukrainian train platform kills 14
item.description: A Russian drone has slammed into a busy platform at a railway station in Ukraine's Dnipro killing at least 14 people.

media:group.media:description: The strike has so far killed 14 people, with at least another 14 confirmed wounded.

item.title: Conflicting accounts emerge after Spanish train collision
item.description: Contradictions have emerged between a private rail operator and the Spanish government over what caused Europe's deadliest train collision since 2013, according to local reports.

media:group.media:description: Emergency services at the scene of a collision between two trains in Urda, Spain, on Wednesday.

item.title: Child care sector faces further changes after shocking abuse exposed
item.description: A proposed national childcare commission will be discussed at a meeting of education ministers next week, as the government faces renewed calls for changes following a Four Corners investigation into Australia's child care system.
item.dc:creator: Adele Ferguson and Chris Gillett

media:group.media:description: Jess Walsh at Senate estimates today.

item.title: North Korean workers sold into Russia then stripped of wages, report finds
item.description: Russian brokers are advertising North Korean workers to companies as part of a forced labour program being used to fund Pyongyang's ballistic missile program, a new report has alleged.
item.dc:creator: Natalie Whiting

media:group.media:description: The network is allegedly run by Moscow-based businessman Vladimir Sokolov (left).

item.title: Albanese is bogged down in grant problem of his own making
item.description: Questions over a golf club grant were just the beginning of a tough week in parliament for Anthony Albanese and his government.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Gould

media:group.media:description: Anthony Albanese's week was clogged up by continuing questions about a golf club grant.

item.title: Alleged Haines attacker likely in state of psychosis, early prison report says
item.description: An initial prison assessment of the man who allegedly attacked federal MP Helen Haines finds no indication of ideological extremism.
item.dc:creator: Danny Tran and Antonia O'Flaherty

media:group.media:description: Brendan Nugent is next due to appear in court in February next year.

item.title: Inflation figures show it's going to get worse before it gets better
item.description: The latest numbers cause pain for households, business and the government. They also show that a tougher approach may well be needed to curb the problem.

media:group.media:description: Jim Chalmers has defended the government's "responsible" budget approach.

item.title: Australia records highest rates of anorexia and bulimia globally
item.description: An international team of researchers has analysed global numbers of people with anorexia and bulimia nervosa, finding an increase of 71 per cent worldwide since 1990.

media:group.media:description: More than 1,000 per 100,000 people in Australia have anorexia or bulimia, the study estimates.

item.title: Teen in 'prime of her life' dies after drive-by shooting south of Brisbane
item.description: Vana-Reese Schuster-Togiatau, who was one of four people shot by two masked men during a boxing event at a Logan nightspot on Saturday night, died on Thursday at Princess Alexandra hospital.
item.dc:creator: Jason Dasey and Ned Hammond

media:group.media:description: Vana-Reese Schuster-Togiatau has died in hospital after being critically injured in a drive-by shooting in Logan.

item.title: Cigarette likely cause of catastrophic Hong Kong fire, report finds
item.description: Hong Kong's chief executive announces the findings of a months-long investigation into the Wang Fuk Court apartment fire that killed 168 people last year.

media:group.media:description: The blaze killed 168 people in November last year.

item.title: Zacharia blames media for troubled stint as White House press secretary
item.description: Former White House press secretary Katie Zacharia has doubled down on support for Donald Trump.

media:group.media:description: Katie Zacharia on one of her first media appearances since leaving the White House.

item.title: NT teen faces terror charges as police seize 3D-printed gun schematics
item.description: A teenage boy charged with serious terrorism and violent extremism offences after a raid in the NT is remanded in custody.
item.dc:creator: Jason Walls, Olivana Lathouris, and Olivia Caisley

media:group.media:description: Paula Hudson says the speed and scale of radicalisation of young people "is becoming one of our most significant challenges".

item.title: Relentless modern-day blitz as Russia rains jet-fuelled death on Ukrainians
item.description: Moscow's new jet-powered drones rip through the sky at hundreds of kilometres an hour, slamming into buildings day and night, and Ukraine's defences are struggling to keep up.

item.title: WA Labor MP vows to 'vigorously defend' US lawsuit over $1m loan
item.description: A Western Australian MP embroiled in a legal dispute over a million-dollar loan in the United States insists everything he did was above board.
item.dc:creator: Keane Bourke

media:group.media:description: Jags Krishnan speaks to reporters outside his electorate office on Thursday.

item.title: Appeal challenges ruling on Sydney teacher's abuse of male students
item.description: A challenge is underway in the Supreme Court after a judge ruled a former Sydney teacher who sexually abused male students in the 1970s could not have foreseen the harm she caused.
item.dc:creator: Isobel Roe

media:group.media:description: Helga Lam was found in a civil case to have engaged in repeated sexual conduct with four boys in 1978 and 1979.

item.title: Actor's death may be first confirmed fatality linked to unapproved peptides
item.description: A coroner has found the death of Australian actor Richard Norton was triggered by injecting unapproved peptides, recommending the TGA consider tougher restrictions.

media:group.media:description: Richard Norton was an actor, stunt person and action choreographer.

item.title: Police search launched for man swept away in Central Australia flooding
item.description: Police say a 60-year-old man is missing after he was reportedly swept off the roof of a vehicle that had "become stuck in floodwater" near Santa Teresa, with police now searching for him with drones and divers.
item.dc:creator: Elsie Lange

media:group.media:description: A police search is underway for a man believed to have been swept into floodwaters near a remote community south of Alice Springs.

item.title: Businesses hoping for 'salvation' from Sydney's new metro line
item.description: After two years of economic pain, the small businesses along Sydney's new Southwest Metro line are breathing a sigh of relief and hoping customers will return in droves.
item.dc:creator: Charlie McLean

media:group.media:description: Talia Gill's business has struggled since the closure of Marrickville Station.
